value.BCS: Broad Community Support is not applicable for this project.
value.Environmental_Social_Categorization_Rati: This is a Category A project according to IFC’s Policy on Environmental and Social Sustainability (2012) due to significant E&S risks and/or impacts inherently associated with primary production of commodities (cashew in Cote d’Ivoire and sesame in Nigeria). These risks include child labor, forced labor, unsafe working conditions associated with the supply chain, the use of agrochemicals including application of pesticides, and significant conversion risk of natural and/or critical habitats. This is a repeat client. The client’s Environmental and Social performance is satisfactory, based on ongoing IFC supervision.Key E&S risks and impacts associated with the project include: (i) the need for enhanced E&S management capacity and systems across the Group’s subsidiaries (ii) assurance of fair, safe and consistent working conditions for all workers across the Group in compliance with IFC PSs including managing risks related to gender based violence and harassment (GBVH); (iii) management of air emissions, noise, effluents, solid and hazardous waste; (iv) food safety management systems, transport management and security risk; (v) management of land acquisition to limit the potential encroachment and ensure there are no legacy claims; vi) safeguarding against issues related to PS2 – 6 in the supply chain by implementing effective due diligence related to such; and vi) sourcing of agricultural products on areas with biodiversity value.
value.IAPS:
While all Performance Standards are applicable to this investment, IFC’s environmental and social due diligence indicates that the investment will have impacts which must be managed in a manner consistent with the following Performance Standards

PS 1 - Assessment and Management of Environmental and Social Risks and Impacts 
PS 2 - Labor and Working Conditions 
PS 3 - Resource Efficiency and Pollution Prevention 
PS 4 - Community Health, Safety and Security 
PS 6 - Biodiversity Conservation and Sustainable Management of Living Natural Resources
